items.text: ▪️H.R. 2955, the Stop Institutional Child Abuse Act. This bipartisan, bicameral bill would provide greater oversight and data transparency for institutional youth treatment programs.

▪️H.R. 2454, the U.S.-Israel PTSD Collaborative Research Act, is legislation that leverages the experiences of the U.S. and Israel to develop best practices in the research, diagnosis, and treatment of Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.

▪️H.R. 1432, the Veterans Service Organizations (VSOs) Equal Tax Treatment Act, is legislation to update the federal tax code, allowing all Congressionally-chartered VSOs to receive tax-deductible donations regardless of wartime membership.

Friday in the First.

Dr. Jerry Edmonds is a resident of Henderson, and the co-founder and president of the Edmonds Tennis and Education Foundation. The Foundation is on a mission to empower young minds through tennis, promoting physical fitness, nutrition, and academic enrichment. Thanks to his efforts, Dr. Edmonds has influenced the lives of over 1,000 youth in northern NC and provided many exposure and life-changing opportunities, including academic scholarships.

Dr. Edmonds and his team are making a positive impact on the lives of countless youngsters, inspiring them to reach their full potential. Using a tennis racquet and ball, one serve at a time, Dr. Edmonds is preparing our next-generation leaders to live the American dream.

Healthcare patients should not have to decide between delaying or prolonging treatment because of high costs. By cosponsoring the following three bipartisan bills, we are working to improve availability and access to healthcare services for those who need it most:

▪️H.R. 2048, the Metastatic Breast Cancer Access to Care Act, a bill to waive arbitrary Social Security and Medicare waiting periods for eligible individuals with metastatic breast cancer because far too many individuals with this disease die waiting for their benefits.

▪️The Physician-Led and Rural Access to Quality Care Act is legislation to create a narrow exemption for physician-owned hospitals and increase access to care in rural areas where there is none.

The Prescription Information Modernization Act of 2025, legislation to allow for digital eLabeling, rather than paper, to become the standard for prescription drugs, allowing for smaller shipping packages and reduced waste.
H.R. 2541, the Nuclear Medicine Clarification Act of 2025, aims to close a loophole that can expose patients to high radiation levels without proper reporting or disclosure. https://t.co/20MocVHC3C
